=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8098-8129 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test still searches for the removed inline REST needle and now fails against the `_fetch_pr_json` helper rewrite.
  WHY: The string `repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/` no longer appears in the inspected window, so the assertion trips and blocks CI.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8485-8545 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The external-finalize guard still lets `merge_conflict` projects into this block, causing redundant PR fetches and bypassing the dedicated `merge_conflict` handling path.
  WHY: Some reviewers framed this as API churn only; others noted it can short-circuit `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed`, `mark_validation_complete`, and related cleanup, so the highest-severity interpretation is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8491-8497 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The numeric guard only warns on a non-numeric `final_merge_pr`; the malformed value can still reach `_fetch_pr_json`/`jq` processing.
  WHY: Reviewers reported malformed values still flowing into the API/jq path, while deepseek reviewed this path as safe.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8498-8518 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Empty or malformed PR JSON can fall through the `_jq_field` checks and leave the block acting on bad data instead of cleanly skipping.
  WHY: One reviewer reported side effects can still fire on empty fields, while another reported the in-memory status can remain unchanged and trigger duplicate terminal handling on the same tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8500-8506 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The temp-file + `mv` state update is not protected against concurrent readers/writers and can leave the state file truncated or invalid.
  WHY: A failure in that sequence can corrupt JSON on disk, causing subsequent `jq` reads to fail until the file is repaired.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8503-8513 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: If the `jq`/`mv` state write fails, `final_merge_status` stays pending on disk and the block re-fires on the next poll tick.
  WHY: Because the persisted state never advances, the same PR is fetched again every cycle until the transient write problem clears.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8518-8528 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The cleaned PR number is passed into `post_tracking_comment` and `tg_send_msg` without validation, which can produce malformed issue/PR links.
  WHY: Those helpers build user-facing links from the value, so a bad number breaks downstream consumers.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8123 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regression test `test_external_finalize_detect_marks_project_complete_when_final_pr_already_merged` still asserts that `repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/` appears in the inspected window, but the fix moved the REST call into `_fetch_pr_json`.
  WHY: The needle is no longer present in that window, so the assertion fails in CI.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8488-8490 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The external-finalize block still runs on `merge_conflict` projects, adding an unnecessary `_fetch_pr_json` call every poll tick.
  WHY: The dedicated `merge_conflict` path already calls `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed`, so the extra fetch burns API budget without changing behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8488-8490 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The same `merge_conflict` path also causes unnecessary API churn in the performance sense.
  WHY: The extra `_fetch_pr_json` call is redundant on every poll tick for pinned pending `final_merge_pr` values.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: A `merge_conflict` project with `final_merge_status=pending` can enter the external-finalize path instead of the dedicated handler.
